name: Tenerife
tagline: Spain's highest peak above year-round sunshine
summary: Tenerife is the largest Canary Island, with spring weather all year. Ride the cable car up Mount Teide, Spain's highest peak, walk volcanic moonscapes, see whales offshore and explore colonial La Laguna.
seasonNote: Warm all year. Winter is high season for northern Europeans; Carnival in February is one of the world's biggest.
arrival: Tenerife South Airport serves the resorts; Tenerife North is near La Laguna. Flights from across Europe.
gettingAround: Good TITSA buses; rent a car to reach Teide and the northwest.
cashTip: Cards work almost everywhere; carry a little cash for beach bars and markets.
foodTip: Papas arrugadas with mojo sauce, grilled cheese and fresh fish in guachinches.
buyTip: Canarian wine, mojo sauces and aloe vera products.
baseArea: Puerto de la Cruz or Costa Adeje
